brief:
The General Authority for Electricity of Jerusalem elected a new board of directors during its general assembly meeting, the Ma'an news agency reported. The vote marks a leadership transition for the utility as it manages power infrastructure serving Palestinian populations across the territories.

The assembly convened to formally select members to the governing board, a routine governance procedure for the public authority. No immediate details emerged regarding the identities of the newly elected board members or their specific portfolios and responsibilities within the organization.
title: Jerusalem electricity authority elects new board of directors
